exclusion: Pregnant woman (blood positive dosage of the hormone béta-hCG) or breast feeding
Against indication to perform an MRI
inclusion: Patients suffering from "probable" MSA according to clinical consensus criteria (Gilman et al, 2008),
Patient covered by the national health system
Blood negative dosage of the hormone béta-hCG for the women old enough to procreate

official_title: Comparison of Cognitive and Behavioral Dysexecutive Syndrome Between Parkinsonian Form and Cerebellar Form of Multiple System Atrophy and Analysis of Correlates With an Imaging Study.
summary: The main objective of the study is to compare the score to the Behavioral Dysexecutive Syndrome Inventory (BDSI) between Parkinsonian Multiple system Atrophy MSA-P patients and cerebellar Multiple System Atrophy (MSA-C) patients matched on disease duration, age (± 7 years) and sex .
title: Cognitive and Behavioral Dysexecutive Syndrome in Multiple System Atrophy
